rename: Native rename tool unavailable; parent explicitly authorized retaining the dedicated original branch. No raw Git rename.

later_integration.authority: Parent explicitly authorized committing the coherent UI batch then reconciling only the own branch with actual origin/main.
later_integration.scope: Verified CI-only main advance; pinned source, manifest/policy, UI APIs and ROOT UI lock unchanged.

initial_and_reconciled_status: Clean including all untracked paths; explicitly authorized own-branch fast-forward only.

shared_amendment.scope: Only core:ui -> core:datastore, positive/reverse-cycle/forbidden-edge guards and process-lifetime rationale. Preserve all other guards and edges.

module_local_lock: Allowed only after actual separately authorized scoped Linux generation; no handwritten records or silent incumbent version changes.
execution_boundary: No Windows JVM/Gradle, WSL installs, shared-cache bootstrap or global setup. Exact scoped Linux generation/testing requires a separate grant.
scope: Authorship receipt and readiness only; not source parity, native execution, gate acceptance, merge authority, fleet activation or whole-app completion.
